check.summary: In the fourth verse ("Who remembered us when we were brought low…"), the refrain "His steadfast love endures forever" is consistently transcribed as "His steadfast love can do forever" three times. "Endures" and "can do" are not similar-sounding words, and the substitution occurs on every line of that verse, indicating the singer likely vocalised different words rather than a one-off Whisper slip. All other lines, including the repeated-phrase compression in the choruses and the plural "lights"→"light", are within acceptable tolerance.
